nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Fetch and analyze Amazon product reviews by ASIN, supporting 15 marketplaces (including US) with star rating filtering. Triggered when users mention Amazon reviews, US reviews, product reviews, buyer complaints, negative reviews, positive reviews, star ratings, review analysis, review sentiment, product improvement suggestions, Vine reviews, verified purchase reviews, competitor review research, Amazon reviews, US reviews, Amazon.com reviews, product feedback, negative review analysis, positive review analysis, star rating filter, review sentiment analysis, product improvement insights, Vine reviews, competitor reviews, customer feedback. Even if users do not explicitly say "reviews", this skill should be triggered whenever the task involves reading, filtering, or analyzing Amazon product customer reviews.

domainCode.description: Amazon domain code, default com. Options: com, ca, co.uk, in, de, fr, it, es, co.jp, com.au, com.br, nl, se, com.mx, ae. Use com for the US site

filterByKeyword.description: Filter reviews by keyword, max length 1000 characters

formatType.description: Format type: all_formats (all formats) or current_format (current format), default all_formats

mediaType.description: Media type: all_contents (all content) or media_reviews_only (reviews with media only), default all_contents

reviewerType.description: Reviewer type: all_reviews (all reviews) or avp_only_reviews (verified purchases only), default all_reviews

sortBy.description: Review sort order: recent (most recent reviews) or helpful (most helpful reviews), default recent

name: nexscope_amazon_reviews_list
title: Amazon Reviews List
